# Giftpack Blog

> A comprehensive resource for AI-powered personalized gifting strategies that drive employee engagement, client retention, and business relationship growth.

Giftpack Blog provides actionable guides, gift ideas, and ROI calculators for corporate gifting across sales, customer success, recruiting, and employee recognition. The blog leverages AI and relationship intelligence to help businesses strengthen professional relationships through strategic gifting.

- Employee recognition
- Client retention

- ROI measurement

- 2025 trends
